notes.title: New Fantasy Game in Development — Join the Skeleton King: Isekai Harem Patreon!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I’m excited to announce the launch of my [b]official Patreon[/b] for [i]Skeleton King: Isekai Harem[/i] — a brand new fantasy game currently in development.[/p][p]This game invites you into the mysterious world of Magiterra, where the story unfolds in immersive chapters and you can be part of its creation.[/p][p]By joining the Patreon, you’ll get:[/p][list][*][p][b]Early access[/b] to new story chapters before anyone else;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exclusive behind-the-scenes[/b] content including concept art, scripts, and dev updates;[/p][/*][*][p]Opportunities to [b]influence the story[/b] through polls and feedback;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exclusive side stories[/b] and unique extras you won’t find anywhere else.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your support is crucial to help bring this amazing world to life and keep development moving.[/p][p]If you want to be part of this journey and help shape the future of Magiterra, join us on Patreon today!
[/p][p]👉 [url="https://www.patreon.com/skih"]https://www.patreon.com/skih[/url]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507981/dd932cf9f7a570443b604a7b181d2b862f89695f.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm. Let’s build this fantasy world together![/p][p]— Marlon[/p]

notes.title: Out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507981/961b422715206ce65448a8c6aa39fc3e14afc6f5.png[/img]

Some memories never fade. They echo in unfinished songs, unspoken words, and promises broken by time.

In the silence of the past, a lost melody waits to be played again.

Soo-ji abandoned music to escape painful memories, but a mysterious voice calls her back. Amid forgotten notes and hidden secrets, she must decide: confront the past or let it slip away forever.

The music you create can be a lament or a redemption. Are you ready to hear the notes of the past?
